description: ISO 4217 minor units: decimal amount to integer minor units and back — Converts up to 200 money amounts between decimal strings and integer minor units (cents, yen, fils) using the ISO 4217 exponent from the SIX Group list, for an agent about to send an amount to a payment API. Returns the exponent, the integer minor amount and the canonical decimal string; JPY is 0, KWD and BHD are 3, CLF is 4. An amount with more fraction digits than the currency allows fails with

amount.description: Decimal amount to convert to minor units. Give amount or minor, or neither to look up the exponent.

exponent.description: Override for currencies absent from ISO 4217 list one or without a minor unit. Wins over the list.

minor.description: Integer minor units to convert to a decimal string.

rounding.description: Only used when amount has more fraction digits than the exponent. half-up: ties away from zero. half-down: ties toward zero. half-even: ties to the even neighbour. up: away from zero. down: toward zero. ceiling: toward +infinity. floor: toward -infinity.

name: minor-units
